## `neuro.int16Array.every`

Instance method on `Int16Array.prototype`.

> Determines whether all the members of an array satisfy the specified test.

## Signatures

```ts
every(input: { int16Array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: number; index: number; array: Int16Array) => unknown; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int16Array.prototype.every` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
